title: EUSPA/OP/12/26 - Personal Microwave Security Scanners
description: The scope of the current procurement is the supply and installation of personal microwave security scanners. Security scanners are aimed to be used in a data centre environment and as such should contribute to prevent attacks such as sabotage and data theft. The selected contractor shall provide the supply, installation, commissioning, training, and maintenance support for long-term operation. The scanners shall be supplied to the following locations: St Germain-en-Laye (GSMC – France) and San Martin de la Vega, Madrid (GSMC – Spain).
